metadata.notes: From the Joyful Game Corner (6, 6) after Lostelle's homecoming, facing her at (6, 5). Her father stands at (5, 5) (pret TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_EventScript_LostellesDaddy): with the room's scene var at 3 he takes the Meteorite, sets VAR_MAP_SCENE_ONE_ISLAND_POKEMON_CENTER_1F to 2 and gives a Moon Stone if the bag has room (checkitemspace; with no room he says so, keeps the stone and gives it on the next talk). Then out to Two Island's harbor and the Seagallop to One Island: until Bill's trip back the sailor offers ONE ISLAND, THREE ISLAND and EXIT (pret EventScript_ChooseDestFromTwoIsland, MULTICHOICE_ISLAND_13). In One Island's Center four coord events stand in column 12, rows 6 to 9, while Celio's VAR is 2 (OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_EventScript_LeaveOneIslandScene): stepped onto from (11, 7) (MidTop), Bill sees the player, who walks a tile east; Bill and Celio say goodbye, the player and Bill walk out, and the script sets Celio's VAR to 3 and VAR_MAP_SCENE_CINNABAR_ISLAND to 3 and sails to Cinnabar. The Seagallop lands at Cinnabar (21, 7) (pret src/seagallop.c), with Bill placed below at (21, 8); Cinnabar's frame script (CinnabarIsland_EventScript_ReturnFromSeviiIslands) runs at once: Bill's line about the Tri-Pass, he walks six tiles south and is gone, and Cinnabar's VAR goes to 4, which adds VERMILION to the Sevii harbors' lists.

checkpoint.title: The Meteorite for a Moon Stone; Bill's goodbye on One Island and the Seagallop to Cinnabar

events.why: A tile west, below Lostelle's father (5, 5).
He takes Bill's Meteorite and gives a Moon Stone.
Out over the door tile, west through town and down to the harbor, above the sailor (8, 6).
The sailor's list: ONE ISLAND, then the crossing to One Island's harbor.
Up into town and into the Pokemon Center, a tile west of the goodbye's coord events in column 12.
Onto (12, 7): Bill's "!" and his first line show at once.
Bill and Celio's goodbye, out of the Center with Bill, the Seagallop to Cinnabar; there Bill's last words, and he walks away south.
